definitions.mean: Equal family-rate mean within each trained seed (mean4), or family 0 only. Then mean and sample SD across the three trained seeds.
definitions.missing: An undefined source denominator stays None. The three-seed mean/SD are omitted if any seed is undefined; available seed points remain visible.
definitions.idle: False actions per 1,000 actual idle opportunities; completion metrics use matured eligible primary requests.
definitions.capacity: Functional eligibility changes and numerical nonzero support are separate. Bridge counts use four actual saved states, not interpolation evidence.
definitions.history_damage: Within each seed, accepted batches with strictly increased history loss divided by accepted batches. Zero accepted batches means undefined.
definitions.points: Seed points receive a small horizontal jitter for visibility; their actual tick and seed are retained in this data file.
definitions.replication: Actors, families, requests, snapshots, candidate batches and probe events do not create extra independent seeds.
